stem:
Alberto ran for exercise every day for 16 days. The table shows how many days he ran each distance.

Exercise
Distance (miles)  1    1 1/2    2    2 1/2    3
Number of Days   ||    |||||   |||   ||||    ||

Which dot plot represents these data?

options.label: A
options.text: Dot plot with dots stacked 2 at 1 mile, 5 at 1 1/2 miles, 3 at 2 miles, 4 at 2 1/2 miles, 2 at 3 miles

options.label: B
options.text: Dot plot with dots stacked 3 at 1 mile, 4 at 1 1/2 miles, 3 at 2 miles, 4 at 2 1/2 miles, 2 at 3 miles

options.label: C
options.text: Dot plot with dots stacked 2 at 1 mile, 4 at 1 1/2 miles, 3 at 2 miles, 5 at 2 1/2 miles, 2 at 3 miles

options.label: D
options.text: Dot plot with 1 dot spaced equally at each tick from 1 to 3 miles

visual_elements: Dot plots A, B, C, D showing different distributions of dots over mile distances as described in options
difficulty_rationale: Requires understanding and comparing data from a table to multiple dot plots, including fractions and multiple quantities to count.
